text:
emi: ran quick bring-up of nebula-v2 (int8) against the mixed-orientation subtitle set. Found reproducible bracket/quote swapping when Arabic/Hebrew spans appear inline with CJK. Posting minimal repro and notes.

emi: failing SRT sample:

```
00:00:05,000 --> 00:00:07,000
\u6771\u4eac\u3067\u3001\u0645\u0631\u062d\u0628\u0627 \u300e\u3042\u308a\u304c\u3068\u3046\u300f
```

emi: baseline (fp16) detok: Tokyo de, (\u0645\u0631\u062d\u0628\u0627) \u300e\u3042\u308a\u304c\u3068\u3046\u300f
nebula-v2 int8 detok observed: Tokyo de, )\u0645\u0631\u062d\u0628\u0627( \u300f\u3042\u308a\u304c\u3068\u3046\u300e

emi: loss of parentheses direction + CJK corner quote order flip. BLEU on subtitle test (mixed CJK+AR+HE):
- fp16 baseline: 31.2
- nebula-v2 int8: 26.0
- nebula-v2 int4 (toy): 30.9

emi: tokenizer IDs are identical across builds for the sample, so tokenization isn't the culprit. I instrumented postprocessing: detok has a bidi reflow pass that uses Bidi_Class of leading codepoint to decide mirroring for bracket pairs.

sami: that heuristic always made me nervous. Any sign U+200E/U+200F (LRM/RLM) are being dropped?

emi: good eye. On int8 path the kernel output bytes for neutral punctuation occasionally differ (extra zero byte) and our C glue layer strips bytes with value 0x00 in a naive memcpy-to-string step. That zeros-out explicit directional marks in the surrounding buffer on some runs.

rachel: I'll run a kernel trace on staging with the failing sample and the quantized runtime flags on. infra-bot can you queue a debug job?

infra-bot: job created: run-1748567890-detok-debug. logs: https://staging.rw/runs/run-1748567890-detok-debug

qa-bot: quick reproduce on staging shows bracket mirror on int8, not on fp16 or int4. Attached diff and minimal failing lines.

emi: interestingly int4 avoids the path where the problematic memcpy executes. So three-way behavior: fp16 ok, int4 ok, int8 bad. Points strongly to a quant-kernel-output layout + C postproc bug.

sami: proposed immediate mitigations:
1) runtime: short-term gate detok bidi mirroring for caption routes (skip mirror step if mixed-orientation token set).
2) eng-ml: expand smoke corpus to 300 mixed SRT lines and add to onboarding CI for quant builds.
3) infra: add kernel trace params and run bisect across qconfig v1..v4.
4) docs/devex: note that detok heuristics assume preserved directional marks.

rachel: doing traces now, will post trace snippet and a small Python checker to look for U+200E/200F removal in postprocess.

emi: also a follow-up: make detok rule use full bidi algorithm window rather than first-codepoint heuristic. That will be slower but safer for captions.

sami: agreed. I'll put a short ticket and flag for canary hold until we confirm patch. For customers using Dedicated captioning routes, flip to fp16 until int8 fix lands.

emi: sample bundle: https://internal.rw/samples/mixed-orient-subtitles-v2.zip

rachel: trace + checker posted to the debug job in ~1.5h.

qa-bot: added testcases to regression suite and will run nightly.

sami: thanks all. If anyone has quick PRs to guard detok (avoid in-place zero-trimming) please ping me for review. :thumbsup:
